import seaborn as sns

try:
    df = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')
except FileNotFoundError:

    exit()

df.dropna(subset=['Income'], inplace=True)

plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.scatterplot(
    data=df,
    x='Income',
    y='Total_Spending',
    hue='Education',
    palette='viridis',  # A perceptually uniform colormap
    alpha=0.7,          # Transparency to handle overplotting
    s=70,               # Size of the markers
    linewidth=0.5       # Border width for markers
)

# Add labels and title for clarity
plt.title('Customer Total Spending vs. Income by Education Level', fontsize=16, weight='bold')
plt.xlabel('Income', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Total Spending on All Products', fontsize=12)

# Improve legend placement to avoid overlapping with data points
plt.legend(title='Education Level', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left', borderaxespad=0.)

# Add a grid for better readability
plt.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.6)

# Ensure all elements fit within the figure area
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
